judge_panel.matching_evidence:
[mathematical] Incorrect overdensity definition in Equation (1)

**What is wrong:** The paper defines
\[
\delta = \frac{n+\bar n}{\bar n}.
\]
This is not the usual overdensity. If \(n=\bar n\), this equation gives \(\delta=2\), not zero.

The surrounding text appears instead to use the standard convention
\[
\delta = \frac{n-\bar n}{\bar n},
\]
judge_panel.reasoning: The report explicitly quotes the incorrect plus-sign equation and gives the corrected minus-sign form. This is a direct detection of the numerator sign-flip injection.
